question: Les Misérables, 2012, had its cast sing live on set. How was the orchestra matched to them?
options: Played live, just off the set
Recorded first, fed into their ears
answer: Recorded afterwards, following the singers. Each actor heard a live pianist through a hidden earpiece, and was free to slow down, break or hold a note. The orchestra was recorded later to fit the voices, reversing the usual order in which singers mime to a track laid down first. The conductor followed the actors.
move: When one performance matters most, make everything else follow it.
trap: Assuming the usual playback method, with singers keeping time to a recording.
reference: Hooper (director), Les Misérables, Working Title Films and Universal Pictures, 2012
